newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Maystadt sees accord on legal status of euro.
newsitem.headline: Maystadt sees accord on legal status of euro.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Thursday it was a near certainty that agreement would be reached on the legal status of the euro in talks here.
"It is virtually certain that there will be an agreement on all of the measures relating to the legal status of the euro," he told reporters during a break in talks of EU finance ministers.

He declined to comment however on whether a failure to agree on a budget discipline pact in Dublin would affect plans to have the proposals for the legal status of the euro approved by EU leaders at a summit starting here on Friday.

Some officials had suggested that failure to agree the budget stability pact would hold up approval of two other issues on the agenda at the Dublin summit -- the euro's legal status and plans for a mechanism to link currencies of countries not immediately in monetary union to the euro.
"We will try to have all three," he said.
The proposals underpinning the legal status of the euro are meant to ensure, among other things, the continuity of bond contracts after the launch of the single currency in 1999.
